notes.title: Spellstruck playtest available now!!
notes.content:
Hello awesome people!

I am so excited to announce my first playtest for Spellstruck is available today!

I just wanted to clarify a few important details before you guys dive in. As Spellstruck is a relatively small game in its current state and with much content planned for it, the playtest has a limit of 1 hour. Dont worry though, I will be adding content up until release in which this timer will be reset/removed.

Secondly, the game is currently without matchmaking so please use in game buttons that interact with your steam overlay in order to invite and join your friends. In case of bugs, (shift-tab) will also do this. If you find yourself without that someone to play with, come and join the discord where there is a dedicated channel to grabbing a buddy to play with and I will be available as much as possible to play with you guys too.  - https://discord.gg/MaQubcqA

Lastly, as a solo dev with limited resources I would like to ask if all who play it would be so kind as to follow the in game link to leave me some feedback about the game or again, use discord. I simply want this to be the best game that I can make it and your help will play a big part in that.

Thank you so much for spending your time playing my game, this honestly means the world to me! If you ever want to talk about the game, come and join the discord and of course, please Wishlist the game if you enjoy yourself. This is the best way to help me as a developer.

Much love,

CyberSmackStudios
